about_the_game:
Fred's Idle Garden is an idle farming simulator which sits on your desktop while you do other things. 

Grow & harvest crops 🥕🌽🍅🥒

Grow various crops and watch the coins roll in! Use your shiny earnings to unlock even more crops, upgrade your characters abilities and buy some nice decorations for your garden. Expand your garden and farm more crops.  

Run your own little cozy shop 🏡 📈

Once you have grown and harvested your crops, you’ll also need a place to sell them! Manage your shop, making sure it's stocked with the crops your customers crave. Keep them happy, and watch your little business thrive!

Decorate your garden 🌳🌼🌷🌵

Decorate your garden with plants and trees to create your own cozy little place.

Fully automated ♾️ 👨‍🌾👩‍🌾

Fred's Idle Garden is a great game for farming multitaskers! Your character does all the hard farm work while you do your own thing. You can place the game wherever you want on your screen, zoom in and out, and it'll quietly do its thing without getting in your way. When you feel like it get back and add new things to your garden or upgrade your character.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+
  • Processor: Any 1.00 GHz or better
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card with DX10 (shader model 4.0) capabilities
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3110M 2.40 GHz or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card with DX10 (shader model 4.0) capabilities
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
